source_references.notes: Real Tesseract.js path with ROI preprocessing, numeric parsing, runtime metadata, and validation guidance.
Teacher-side use of numeric OCR; template-digit and cnn-onnx remain placeholders in the source.

known_boundaries: Default Tesseract whitelist covers digits, decimal point, and minus sign; plus can be configured, but scientific notation is unsupported.
Current pixel evidence is synthetic and does not validate a real device display or browser compatibility matrix.
Character normalization can turn letters such as O/o into digits, so rawText and physical-range checks remain necessary.
Mock output must never replace failed real OCR.
Post-processing accuracy must be reported separately from raw OCR accuracy.
